Bulldozers Demolish Structures in Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh

Bulldozers were deployed in both Uttarakhand's Udham Singh Nagar and Uttar Pradesh's Ghaziabad to demolish structures. In Uttarakhand, the demolitions were described as being carried out under the guise of removing encroachments, with a specific mention of a 'mazar' being razed. In Ghaziabad, the Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority (UPSIDA) had reportedly issued notices 15 days prior to the demolitions, which resulted in the destruction of homes.
